opening.argument: The video walks viewers through a Dogecoin purchase: obtain Bitcoin, send it to a Mercatox deposit address, then enter a price and amount on a BUY DOGE order form. Those are observable steps in a purchasing tutorial, not evidence of a promised return or a completed purchase. The description also discloses that its sign-up links are affiliate links that may earn the creator a commission. Nothing in the supplied material establishes a deceptive promise, impersonation, or concealed diversion of money or data. The record supports educational instruction combined with disclosed affiliate promotion.
